claim: This aerial clip shows ships stuck in the Strait of Hormuz.
caption:
WRONG LOCATION: This aerial clip shows the coast near Chittagong airport, Bangladesh, and the Karnaphuli River—not ships stopped in the Strait of Hormuz. Full Fact’s 22 October 2026 check matched the shoreline and river to Bangladesh. This verdict concerns this video’s location; it does not establish the wider shipping situation in Hormuz.
Source: https://fullfact.org/world/viral-clip-ships-hormuz-false/
Original claim: https://www.facebook.com/reel/1828760951600371
Card reviewed: 27 October 2026; source rechecked: 28 October 2026. AI-assisted research and design, with independent automated evidence/editorial review.
evidence_summary: Full Fact geolocates the coastline and curved river to Chittagong/Bangladesh. Conclusion limited to video location.

review_provenance.review_notes: Parent approved scoped factual claim and independently verified screenshot provenance/rights. Executor read Full Fact and inspected original PNG/final JPEG. See sources/hormuz-editorial-review.json.

claim: A viral video documents a real man rescuing, raising and releasing an injured polar bear cub.
caption:
FALSE: The polar-bear-cub rescue story in the viral video is not a documented real rescue. Lead Stories traced the clip to an AI-content creator and reported a creator-added AI disclosure on the original 21 October 2026 Instagram post. Those origin and disclosure findings are attributed to Lead Stories; we did not independently inspect the original video.

AI illustration — not actual footage. The image is a new, generic illustration of a cub. It is not a frame from the viral video and is not evidence of any rescue.

Source: Sarah Thompson, Lead Stories, 23 October 2026:
https://leadstories.com/hoax-alert/2026/10/fact-check-fake-video-of-man-who-rescues-raises-releases-injured-polar-bear-cub.html

Checked 28 October 2026. AI-assisted research, design and original illustration; independent automated evidence/editorial review. This finding concerns this specific video, not all wildlife rescues.
evidence_summary: Lead Stories traces the viral rescue story to an AI-content creator and reports an AI disclosure. Original-post observations are attributed to this reporting; no independent original-video inspection or detector measurement is claimed.
claim_date_note: Fact-check publication establishes circulation by October23. October21 original-post date is secondary attribution to Lead Stories, not independently inspected.
